name: adk-kotlin-agent-builder
description: Builds ADK Kotlin agents: LlmAgent with instructions and tools, @Tool function tools generated by KSP, hand-written tools, agent-as-tool and MCP, Sequential / Parallel / Loop agents and LLM transfer between sub-agents, callbacks and plugins, session state, artifacts, long-running and confirmation-gated tools, running with InMemoryRunner, and unit tests with a fake Model. Use when asked to create an agent, add or fix a tool, branch or loop between agents, run steps in parallel, pause for user approval, read or write session state, or test an agent. Don't use for build, dependency and CI questions (use adk-kotlin-setup).
